content.comment_body: I have a [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] controller, programmed to save analog input data onto the SD memory. I'd like to know if the SD card data can be accessed directly via the [product_name] and viewed in Excel. I've installed the [product_name] Excel add-in, but when I try to connect by IP address, Excel reports a 'runtime error 91'. I'm using MS Office Professional Plus 2010.
No, the [product_name] can't access data on the SD card directly. It can only log and access variables.
Understood, thank you for clarifying. Do you know why the 'runtime error 91' appears in Excel when recording or reading values? Any advice on resolving this?
I'm not sure about this. You may want to contact [company_name] support and open a request.

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried using the [product_name] together with Excel to access historical data stored on a [company_name] [product_name] controller SD card, but found out this feature isn't supported. The user also encountered a runtime error in Excel when trying to record and read values through the tool, though the thread does not offer a solution. The discussion highlights product limitations and a lack of error resolution guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: User expected to have direct access to data stored on the controller's SD card via the [product_name] add-in for Excel, and also expected the process to work without runtime errors or technical issues.
pain_keywords: inability to access SD card data
